source.title: DIN NILM: prototype a replaceable Wi-Fi OLED front-panel host

labels.name: idea
labels.description: New product or feature idea from intake

source.body:
## Outcome
Prototype a replaceable Wi-Fi and front-panel display host for the open DIN NILM stack, connected through the isolated host boundary and a stable SPI protocol rather than coupled to one metering riser.

## Candidate configurations
1. **Legacy-compatible baseline:** LOLIN D1 mini v4 + 0.66-inch I2C OLED shield. It directly follows the existing `din_isolated_SPI` mechanical concept; the I2C display leaves the host SPI bus available, but ESP8266 memory and throughput limit raw-waveform workloads.
2. **Preferred integrated front panel:** Heltec WiFi Kit 32 V3. ESP32-S3, Wi-Fi/BLE, integrated 0.96-inch 128x64 OLED, two SPI controllers, and a narrow 50.2 x 25.5 mm board. It needs a custom keyed carrier because it is not D1-mini pin-compatible.
3. **D1-form-factor migration prototype:** ESP32 D1 Mini / Mini32 with the LOLIN I2C OLED shield. It offers stronger processing and multiple SPI controllers while retaining shield mechanics, but clone pin mapping, sourcing continuity, antenna clearance, and certification evidence must be verified per supplier.
4. **Richer UI alternative:** LILYGO T-Display S3. Its integrated 1.9-inch LCD provides a stronger front panel, but it is not Wemos-compatible and needs a custom carrier, enclosure window, and GPIO audit.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Keep the display on I2C or a dedicated display interface so one hardware SPI controller remains reserved for the isolated metrology bus
- [ ] Define connector, power, reset, IRQ, isolation, antenna, USB-service, and front-panel-window constraints
- [ ] Demonstrate local status, channel health, power/energy summary, network state, and safe commissioning without exposing raw account credentials
- [ ] Benchmark loss-detectable SPI capture and MQTT/bulk upload; do not route sustained NILM waveform storage through an ESP8266 if it cannot meet the measured rate
- [ ] Keep acquisition functional when the display or Wi-Fi service is absent or rebooting
- [ ] Publish firmware abstraction for ESP8266 and ESP32-S3-class hosts and document which features require the higher-capability target
- [ ] Produce enclosure-fit renders and a serviceable stacked-board carrier compatible with the safe v2 isolation boundary

## Recommendation
Use the D1 mini + I2C OLED only to recover and validate the legacy stack. Use Heltec WiFi Kit 32 V3 as the leading integrated front-panel prototype; keep a custom ESP32-S3 carrier as the long-term sourcing-controlled option.
